newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 14.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- Choi Hyung-woo, a leading New Korea Party member, was operated on after suffering a stroke.
- Lee Hoi-chang, new chairman of ruling New Korea Party, told a news conference that being leader of the party had nothing to do with running for the presidential election in December

- Representative Lee Hoi-chang, a ruling camp presidential hopeful, was elected as new chairman of the ruling New Korea Party on Thursday. He has emerged as an almost certain standard bearer of the New Korea Party in the presidential election in December, sources said.

- The selection of Lee Hoi-chang, the new chairman of the ruling New Korea party and a leading presidential contender, is expected to spark reprecussions from rival contenders. The rivals are calling for the separation of the presidential bid from the chairmanship, saying it is impossible for the party to oversee a fair presidential nomination if the new chairman competes for the candidacy.
